gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Big, round, unmistakably loud. Bloody throws heavy bowls across the top, while Noto Sans Telugu sits beneath with a high midline and counters that stay open to the outside.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana brings wide channels into each counter and big open lowercase forms, a friendly plain sans. Bloody counters with round, shouting bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai reads puffy and friendly, like inflated glass beads. Over a full page those rounded, open letters keep going easily, while Bloody's heavy bowls up top give the eye a loud place to start.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Noto Sans Thai Looped looks bold because its lowercase bodies stand so tall, with generous gaps where the curves end. Shrink Bloody down and its commanding bowls lose their punch.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Inviting, first of all: Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps its rounded letters open, with bowls that fill the line like inflated shapes. Noto Sans Tifinagh then lets Bloody's big round lowercase bowls do the shouting above it.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap and leans on a dominant x-height. Noto Sans Tirhuta then stays contemporary and clean under Bloody, whose big round bowls carry all the menace.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic leaves very little gap between x-height and cap height, with open mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined. Paragraphs under Bloody's heavy bowls would feel friendly and tidy.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai makes words read as solid blocks, not skylines. Its generous space between curve ends and stems gives Bloody's commanding round bowls a modern, approachable partner.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Big round lowercase bowls are what make Bloody so commanding and, well, bloody. Noto Sans Vithkuqi does the quiet work, with open throats on a, c, e and s and barely any step up to capitals.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Hulking is the word for Noto Sans Wancho, like thick chalk pressed hard, under Bloody's commanding bowls. Noto Sans Wancho keeps a wide gap at the e terminal, so a long passage stays clean and contemporary.
